standard_prerequisites.name: One-step lifting through a square-zero ideal
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the factorization C -> B'/J' -> Lambda used inside the construction.

standard_prerequisites.name: Equational criterion for flatness
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the relation sum epsilon_i phi(b_i) = 0 into the displayed system with a_{ij} in R and lambda_j in Lambda.

core_obligations: Induction on the number of generators of J reduces to the case J = (h).
Write h = sum epsilon_i b_i with epsilon_i in I; the flatness equational criterion produces lambda_j in Lambda and a_{ij} in R with phi(b_i) = sum a_{ij} lambda_j and sum_i epsilon_i a_{ij} = 0.
Set C = B[x_1, ..., x_m]/(b_i - sum a_{ij} x_j) with its displayed map to Lambda, and apply the lift-once lemma to get C -> B'/J' -> Lambda.

Since B is smooth over R, lift the composite B -> C -> B'/J' to a map alpha: B -> B'; the lift satisfies alpha(h) = sum epsilon_i a_{ij} xi_j + sum epsilon_i theta_i = 0 because I^2 = 0, and beta composed with alpha equals phi.
proof_roadmap: Generator induction; flatness relations; quotient algebra C; one-step lift; killing h via I^2 = 0.
difficulty_reason: A four-step argument; the substantive step is the equational-criterion relations and the I^2 = 0 cancellation, both written out.
